posts.name: Koga
posts.cooked:
I had ordered new EE and the RC/IR set pretty much as soon as they came in stock, then later I decided to get a Mr. Chomps plushie so placed an order for that too. Even though they all came in the same box I got 2 sets of promos, since they were 2 orders. Didn't see the 2nd set till I looked in Mr. Chomps' arms, he was holding them for me. Will probably give the extra set to a friend at my game club that has Sentinels and may have missed getting the promos. Already gave away my first Young Legacy a while back, had gotten an extra one from the RC kickstarter. Now I keep that one in a safe place and just use a printout that happens to have more vibrant colors than the original and thicker too to match the rest of the cards better.

Pretty much replaced my entire set of Sentinels since there were problems with most of the cards during printing (the color issue) and sleeving my cards now that the cards have become more consistant in production and seem to get a ton of use. They stay in your hands a lot more often than cards in deck builders, since those games usually have you draw a new hand, so some cards you just keep holding onto get really worn. Just need to replace my Shattered Timelines now, the cards are wearing down quite a bit on Omnitron-X and Chrono-Ranger, they get a ton of use.
